T01.reason: The radius is renormalised so the 1979-1988 average becomes a perfect reference circle and the white wedge reads as a share of that circle, changing what radius is mapped to.

T02.reason: A single area-to-scale blob with a linear year timeline becomes a polar day-of-year dial with a growing wedge and past-year traces.

T03.reason: The white wedge changes from this year so far (calendar-anchored) to a rolling last twelve months behind and ahead of the hand, redefining what the main shape encodes.

T04.reason: The dial, circle and wedge are unchanged; only the legend and readout are refined to describe a 'ring' of equal area and rename the past-year traces.

T05.reason: A whole disc of today's ice area with a September-low timeline is replaced by a polar day-of-year dial with a swept wedge.

T06.reason: The balance stays the same; the difference gauge with its histogram moves from above the beam to a hanging dial below the pivot with an added units label.

T07.reason: The balance with stacked slabs is kept but the grey partial top slab in each pan is no longer drawn.

T08.reason: Only the displayed date and values differ; the picture is otherwise identical.

T09.reason: Same dome-pan balance, refined so the suspension strings no longer cut across the domes and the footer text no longer overlaps the timeline labels.

T10.reason: The wedge changes from calendar year-to-date to a rolling last twelve months, with a year-over-year bar on the hand.

T11.reason: The same balance design shown at a later moment (2026), the differences being data-driven tilt, values and missing-ice halo.

T12.reason: The dotted 1979-1990 reference outline, the blue surplus rim and the running balance figure are removed while the dial is kept.

T13.reason: The small unlabelled tick gauge above the pivot becomes a larger labelled dial with a histogram of past daily differences, on the same balance.

T14.reason: Only the date and the numbers change by a couple of days.

T15.reason: The large left-hand stat panel (today's value, difference, balance) is removed, leaving only a small centred caption, with the dial unchanged.

T16.reason: The hanging difference dial is widened with its scale labels moved below and a taller histogram, on the same balance.
